text:
Situation: Ropivacaine hydrochloride has been on the FDA drug shortage list since 2018-03-23 and remains current as of 2026-10-21. Corvale East holds 9 days of 2 mg/mL 20 mL vials; Corvale General holds 15 days. Other concentrations at both sites range from 8 to 28 days. Corvale Lakeside holds 19 days of 2 mg/mL 20 mL vials.

Why (FDA record): FDA first posted the shortage on 2018-03-23 and lists Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC with the same initial posting date. A product label (NDC 63323028821) names Fresenius Kabi USA, LLC as a registered plant (FEI 1450022). FDA inspection 1174894 at that plant ended 2022-06-30 and was classified OAI; the classification letter is dated 2024-04-30. FDA inspection 1123748 at the same plant ended 2020-05-18 and was also classified OAI; the classification letter is dated 2024-05-22.

Our position: The shortage is longstanding. Internal stock is uneven. The rule‑ranked transfer is the only option that uses verified on‑hand inventory and does not depend on unconfirmed supplier availability.

Recommended actions:
1. Transfer 7 vials of ropivacaine hydrochloride 2 mg/mL 20 mL from Corvale General to Corvale East — requires pharmacy director approval of the transfer request.
2. Evaluate purchase from Amneal Pharmaceuticals LLC — requires buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list and no plant identified on label.
3. Evaluate purchase from Armas Pharmaceuticals Inc. — requires buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list and no plant identified on label.
4. Evaluate purchase from Civica, Inc. — requires buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list and no plant identified on label.
5. Evaluate purchase from Gland Pharma Limited — requires buyer approval; product not on FDA shortage list and no plant identified on label.

Not recommended: No other transfers or purchases at this time.
